PRO red::set_refcam, cam self->getdetectors ; load tags IF size(cam,/type) EQ 7 THEN BEGIN idx = -1 IF ptr_valid(self.detectors) THEN idx = where(*self.detectors EQ cam) IF idx lt 0 THEN BEGIN print,'set_refcam: Could not find ' + cam + ' in camera list.' idx = 0 ENDIF ENDIF ELSE BEGIN idx = byte(cam) IF idx ge n_elements(*self.detectors) THEN BEGIN print,'set_refcam: Index ', idx, ' out of bounds.' idx = 0 ENDIF ENDELSE self.refcam = idx END
